products.title: *OFF-SITE* Itamar Srulovich & Sarit Packer in conversation with Samin Nosrat • Honey & Co Daily
products.body_html:
This event is being hosted by the JCCSF. For details and tickets click here. 

Join a heartfelt conversation about food, hospitality, and how the simple act of gathering around the table helps us build community and feel at home with each other.

For Itamar Srulovich and Sarit Packer, the Israeli-born chefs behind London’s beloved Honey & Co., cooking has never been just about what’s on the plate. Their restaurants, cookbooks, and podcast are all rooted in a simple idea: hospitality is an everyday practice of generosity, connection, and making room for others. Join Itamar and Sarit for a special evening with their longtime friend, bestselling author Samin Nosrat.

“If you’re messing about and you can’t pay attention to your guest, that’s the worst thing. Nobody cares if you flambé stuff.” – Sarit Packer 

“The food does not matter… It’s the chance to sit and talk and connect with people.” – Samin Nosrat 

“The food needs to be just good enough.” – Itamar Srulovich

products.title: Nik Sharma Author Talk • Fundamentals of Flavor: 100 Recipes for the Science of Better Cooking
products.body_html:
Nik Sharma is the bestselling author of cookbooks celebrated for blending culinary science with deeply personal storytelling: Season, The Flavor Equation, and Veg-Table. A former molecular biologist, Sharma brings a unique lens to the kitchen, where flavor is both a feeling and a formula. He serves as Editor in Residence at America's Test Kitchen, where he hosts the James Beard nominated YouTube show Flavor Forward with Nik Sharma, is a co-host of the show In the Test Kitchen on Netflix, and is a cast member on America’s Test Kitchen show on PBS. Sharma is the creator of the award-winning blog Nik Sharma Cooks (formerly A Brown Table), and his writing and photography have been featured in The San Francisco Chronicle, The New York Times, The Guardian, and The Wall Street Journal, among others. He lives in Los Angeles, California, where he's always dreaming up his next recipe.

Paolo Lucchesi is the editorial director of Resy. Prior to Resy, he worked at the San Francisco Chronicle and Eater, both as an editor and reporter. He has written several books, including “Flour + Water: Pasta” and “A Burger to Believe In.” He lives in San Francisco.
